verdict: Sir. Ahmed presents a masterclass in backend developer minimalism while the front end display completely crashes.
detailedQuote: Dressed like a lead software engineer who wandered into a lecture hall by mistake, Sir. Ahmed pairs a standard dark tee with alien-esque foam footwear. The entire fit screams tech-bro comfort, perfectly complemented by the HDMI signal failing behind him.
